events.title: OpenAI GPT-4.1 released
events.summary: OpenAI released GPT-4.1 on April 14, 2025 — improved coding, instruction following, and a 1M-token context window in the API.
events.about: GPT-4.1 and GPT-4.1 mini targeted developers with better long-context coding and lower latency than GPT-4o. The release continued OpenAI's cadence of incremental API models between flagship consumer launches.

narrative.whyChosen: GPT-4.1 pushed long-context coding further in the developer API tier.
narrative.whyImportant: Million-token API models reduced chunking for codebase-aware tools.
narrative.problemSolved: Developers needed stronger coding models with larger context at API scale.
